order.why: lower level of the residential model; its estimates give the dwelling inclusive value of the PUMA level
upper level; reads the dwelling inclusive value as a data column (the shipped data hold that of the reference dwelling model)
independent; smallest school model (141 zones), quickest test of the location-mixture likelihood
independent; largest expression (4 home slots x 1,144 zones), run last

notes: Models 04 to 08 do not depend on each other or on 01 and 02; any order works. There is no folder 03 (the former three-level residential model is in _superseded_1117/).

If you re-estimate 02 and want the PUMA model on your own inclusive values, rebuild the PUMA data with DWELLING_ESTIMATES=<your 02 estimates csv> (see 01_residential_puma/input/code/README.md) before running 01.
